Processing_Method: Derived from DB08 Waste Pollution Sites database. Extract Latitude/Longitude. Assign CRS EPSG:4326. Spatial validate against G01/G02. Attribute join all DB08 fields. Classify by Waste_Type_Code. G55 is the GIS representation of DB08 — never edit G55 directly. Rule: G55 must always be regenerated from DB08 CLEAN.
Key_QC_Rules: DB08 must be QC_Status = CLEAN before G55 generated. G55 feature count must equal DB08 CLEAN count. Geometry X/Y must match DB08 Lat/Lon within 0.00001 degrees. All points must fall within G01 study state polygons. Note: waste site coordinates should be treated carefully — some sites may be near schools or water sources — flag these explicitly in the QC report.

Dependent_Layers: G55 CLEAN + G09 G10 G13 G05
Processing_Method: Buffer all active waste dump sites (Waste_Type_Code != WST07 and Activity_Status = Active) by 500m (primary zone) and 1500m (secondary zone). Apply topographic flow direction (G13) to model leachate pathway direction. Intersect with river buffer (BUF007 = 300m from rivers) to identify sites likely to contaminate watercourses. Score each zone: High (direct river connection via flow path) / Moderate (within 1500m; no direct connection) / Low (beyond 1500m).
Key_QC_Rules: Buffer distance (500m/1500m) must be documented in BUFFER_RULES.csv — add BUF008 (leachate primary zone) and BUF009 (secondary zone). Sensitivity test with 250m and 1000m buffers. Water contamination risk must be flagged for all dump sites within BUF007 (300m river buffer). Medical and chemical waste sites (WST03/WST04) automatically assigned High leachate risk regardless of buffer.

Processing_Method: Primary source: DB08 records where Open_Burning = Yes. Supplement with Sentinel-5P TROPOMI HCHO/NO2 hotspot analysis (GEE export). Field-verified burning events from community reports. Assign confidence rating: High (field confirmed) / Medium (remote sensing hotspot corroborated by community report) / Low (single-source remote sensing only).
Key_QC_Rules: Confidence rating mandatory for every G57 feature. Low-confidence features must not be used as confirmed burning locations in health risk analysis. Cross-check: open burning locations near communities should align with community-reported respiratory complaints where DB01/DB02 data available.

Processing_Method: For each community: (1) Count DB08 sites within 1km (direct exposure). (2) Compute minimum distance to nearest active dump site. (3) Assess whether community falls within G56 leachate risk zone. (4) Flag if community is downwind/downstream of G57 burning site. Normalise each component 0–100. Weight: dump proximity 40% + leachate risk 35% + burning exposure 25%. Produce WP_Score per community.
Key_QC_Rules: Waste pollution exposure uses proximity-based logic (similar to G30 erosion exposure — not area overlay). Active sites only for primary analysis. IND18 and IND19 computed directly from this layer. Cross-check: communities reporting water quality problems or health complaints in DB01 should score higher on G58. Medical waste (WST03) sites within 500m of any community must generate HIGH_WASTE_HAZARD flag automatically.
